item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 04/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a band of clouds, there will be a few rain patches over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Thursday. The weather will be slightly cooler in the following few days. A cool replenishment of the monsoon will affect the coast of southern China midweek next week. Temperatures will fall further over the region.
